[[Jahk Kihngah]] can be found wandering around outside [[the Kodash Bazaar]], at the nearest [[resurrection shrine]].

==Locations==
*[[Vabbi]]
**{{NPC location|Vehtendi Valley}}

==Dialogue==
:''"I hear people talk about these unusually large rodents all of the time, but I've never seen one. I don't think they exist."''

==Trivia==
*His name is a reference to Jake King, who was one of the [[Game credits#Guidebook Alpha Testers|Guidebook Alpha Testers]] for [[Nightfall]].
*''"Rodents Of Unusual Size? I don't think they exist"'' is a line from the novel and film [[w:The Princess Bride|The Princess Bride]].
